request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:FIGHTER

layers.text: Dip the toffee cube in dark chocolate: its lower third is coated in dark chocolate #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 highlight, with a wavy dripping edge, so the upper part with the face stays golden toffee; the knob on top is dark chocolate; the wrapper wings become cream white with thin gold stripes. Keep the face, the lollipop, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
